payout_quote: There are 4 tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum. The higher tier you're on, the less you pay in fees. Excluding GST, the highest rate is 20% and the lowest rate is as low as 12.5%.
steps: Create a free Airtasker account and set up a Tasker profile with your skills, services, and service area.
Browse tasks posted publicly by customers and make an offer (bid) with your price and timeframe.
Get selected by the customer; complete the task as agreed.
Request payment through Airtasker Pay; the customer's payment is released to your bank account minus the tiered service fee (20% down to 12.5%).
catches: Offers are competitive — the customer picks one Tasker, so most bids earn nothing.
Airtasker deducts a service fee of 20% down to 12.5% depending on your tier; you keep the rest.
Task budgets are set by the customer; Airtasker publishes no fixed Tasker pay range.
Tier rates shown are Australia (excl. GST); UK rates follow the same 4-tier structure.
Ratings matter: poor reviews reduce future selection.
biggest_catch: You only get paid if a customer picks your offer and you complete the task — and Airtasker takes 20% down to 12.5% of every completed task.
eligibility: Anyone who can create a free Airtasker account and legally perform local tasks in a supported market (Australia/UK primarily).
timing: Tasks post continuously; payment releases via Airtasker Pay after task completion.
